# Welcome to the DIY Hydro Fieldwork course pages [Under construction] {.unnumbered}

This site introduces hands-on hydrology experiments designed for field-based learning, developed by the [Hydro Group](https://www.geography.unibe.ch/research/hydrology/index_eng.html) of the [University of Bern](https://www.geography.unibe.ch/forschung/hydrologie).

**Developers:** 
Ueli Ammann, University of Bern, ueli.ammann  unibe.ch
Bettina Schaefli, University of Bern, bettina.schaefli unibe.ch
Natalie Ceperley, University of Bern, natalie ceperley unibe.ch


Use the navigation pane to explore each experiment.

[Please report any questions/bugs](https://github.com/hydro-unibern/DIY-fieldwork/issues).

## Funding

The development of the course, the pilot and test phase is funded through the [Impuls Lehre](https://www.gutelehre.unibe.ch/foerderangebote/impuls__lehre) programme (2026–2028) of the University of Bern.
